name: title
description: A cover slide: title, subtitle and meta (authors, affiliation, date) on the left margin, an optional figure on the right, and a footer line at the bottom.

regions.name: title
regions.description: The talk title, in the cover size (the slide's `title` sugar goes here), under the kicker from the slide's `section`; it fills the top rows and the title sits at the bottom of them.

regions.name: subtitle
regions.description: Subtitle below the title, in the heading size and the muted color.

regions.name: meta
regions.description: Authors, affiliation, venue and date, on the bottom margin above the footer; elements stack with a small gap, in the note size.

regions.name: figure
regions.description: Optional figure on the right margin, beside the title column. Empty: the cover is unchanged. With an element: two columns.

regions.name: footer
regions.description: Footer line on the bottom margin, typically a source, license or event line.

variables.name: --title-width
variables.description: Measure (maximum width) of the title, subtitle and meta column.

variables.name: --meta-gap
variables.description: The least space between the subtitle and the meta block.

variables.name: --figure-width
variables.description: Width of the figure column when the figure region holds an element; the title column takes the rest.
